title: Preparation of Mg/Al Layered Double Hydroxide–Oleate Intercalation Compound by a Reconstruction Method under Hydrothermal Condition
abstract: Abstract                A layered double hydroxide–oleate intercalation compound was successfully synthesized by a reconstruction method under a hydrothermal condition from calcined hydrotalcite. The LDH–oleate intercalation compound exhibits attractive properties such as the reversible themoresponsive change in the basal spacing and the swelling in organic solvents.
